StatsResetTooltip: Hold Ctrl and click to reset
ShopEnableTooltip:
While Auto register is on, once %CURRENCY% reaches the threshold in the lobby, buy the items checked below through GatherBuddy Reborn, then walk back to %REGISTRAR% and keep registering.
If there is nothing to buy, shopping is skipped and registering continues.
StopWhenFullTooltip: Before the next registration, turn Auto register off when %CURRENCY% is full or the remaining space is less than one gain (estimated from the largest gain in recent records).
ShopAbortTooltip: Abort shopping and turn Auto register off
